chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Ismāʿīl ibn ʿAbd al-Khāliq, who said:
I heard him say: It is not proper for the Imam to stand up after he has prayed until everyone behind him has completed what he missed of the salat (prayer).

key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the prayer leader in congregational salat (prayer)
key_terms.مَا فَاتَهُ: what a person missed from the salat (prayer)
key_terms.مَنْ خَلْفَهُ: those praying behind him in congregation
key_terms.يَقُومَ: to stand up or rise from his place
key_terms.يَقْضِيَ: to complete or make up what was missed

ai.seo_question: Should the Imam leave his place immediately after ending the congregational salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a ruling on the conduct of the Imam after concluding the congregational salat (prayer). It indicates that the Imam should remain in his place until those praying behind him complete the portions of the salat (prayer) they missed.
